messages:
anand: starting private/vpc delivery prep for ACME corp. We have a 38GB installer image that exceeds single-manifest limits; planning manifest fragmentation across 12 fragments. Need signer handoff plan. Change window Thu 02:00-05:00 UTC. Can we get ops + packaging eyes?

maria: ack. packaging will produce fragmented-manifest v=2026-03-26-01. We'll include per-frag sha256 and a top-level index.json that lists order + sigs.

liz: what are rollback criteria? also need deploybot healthchecks for each fragment apply and final integrity verify.

kevin: KMS signer rotation happened last week but ops-bot still has active cosign key. ops-bot, can you generate ephemeral signer token scoped to this manifest epoch?

ops-bot: @kevin starting ephemeral signer token request
ops-bot: cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/delivery --payload index.json --expiry 6h
ops-bot: token: ephem-9f7a (expires 2026-03-26T08:00:00Z)

maria: packaging plan: build -> split --size 4GB -> attach per-frag digest -> sign each frag -> assemble index.json -> cosign index.json with ephem token. We'll push fragments to mirror-1 and mirror-2 and then update sealed-manifest pointer in the customer's offline mirror bucket.

deploy-bot: deploy action queued: "private-delivery:manifest-fragmentation:v2026-03-26-01". Steps:
- upload fragments to mirrors
- verify per-frag sha256
- update sealed-manifest pointer (atomic rename on customer bucket)
- run post-apply validator (sha check + installer --verify)

anand: rollback plan proposal: if post-apply validator fails or >0.5% customer installs error rate within 30m of cutover, then rollback = re-point sealed-manifest to previous-epoch (v2026-03-19-01). We should be able to repoint within 3m.

liz: add canary: during window, seed 3 pilot hosts (internal). If pilot success 15m, continue to 50% customer mirrors, then full.

maria: packaging will tag fragments with epoch and frag index e.g. v2026-03-26-01-frag-01.sha256

kevin: network considerations: mirror transfer parallelism limited to avoid saturating customer egress. Suggest concurrency=3 per mirror.

anand: operations checklist summarized in release notes. @release-bot can you append these bullets to the customer-facing delivery note?

release-bot: added snippet to release-notes: "Private/VPC: Fragmented installer delivery v2026-03-26-01 for ACME corp. Change window Thu 02:00-05:00 UTC. Canary: 3 internal hosts then gradual. Rollback: repoint to v2026-03-19-01 if post-apply validator fails or install error rate >0.5% within 30m." :white_check_mark:

maria: small code snippet for packaging if helpful:
```
# split and compute digests
split -b 4G installer.bin inst.part.
for f in inst.part.*; do sha256sum "$f" >> frags.sha256; done
# sign each fragment
for f in inst.part.*; do cosign sign --key $EPHEM_KEY --payload "$f"; done
# assemble index with order and sigs
python build_index.py --frags frags.sha256 --out index.json
cosign sign --key $EPHEM_KEY index.json
```

liz: pre-run checks (run 2h before window):
- verify ephem token exists and expiry > 4h
- mirror quotas OK
- deploy-bot has permission to atomic-rename in customer bucket
- backups of previous sealed-manifest tested

anand: contingency: if ephem token fails at apply time, fallback = sign index with secondary HSM key (requires manual @kevin approve). That will add ~10m to window.

kevin: acknowledged.

deploy-bot: healthcheck logs (dry-run):
[DRYRUN] uploaded frag 1/12 -> sha match
[DRYRUN] uploaded frag 2/12 -> sha match
[DRYRUN] index signed -> OK
[DRYRUN] atomic repoint -> OK

anand: final ask: who's on-call for the window? liz (SRE primary), kevin (infra), maria (packaging), anand (release lead). I'll create postmortem template in #postmortems after the window.

liz: i'm on-call and will be watching logs. set alerts: installer-verify-failures >=1, mirror-transfer-failures >=3, sealed-manifest-repoint-duration > 180s

maria: will push artifacts to private staging now for final checksum.

anand: thanks all. We'll reconvene 01:00 UTC for final sign-off. :eyes:
